title: Hearty Winey Italian Ikura Piadina
description: A winey and gooey Italian dish featuring ikura and ferment kimchi, perfect for a lacto-vegetarian meal prep option, served in the form of a piadina.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the piadina dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the mozzarella cheese over the dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Top the cheese with ikura, ferment kimchi, and chopped fresh basil.
Drizzle the red wine over the filling, being careful not to overflow.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Fold the edges of the dough over the filling to form a piadina.
Bake the piadina in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
